QuestInfo.name: Bruce's Report
QuestInfo.1: Bruce has compiled all his findings on the Golems and their evolution, and wants to announce it to the world. First, though, he needs new samples from all the Golems to back up his claims. Go collect 30 pieces of each kind of rubble.
QuestInfo.2: You managed to get 30 pieces of each kind of rubble, and delivered them to Bruce. He was quite thankful for helping him finish his research.

0.0: We have made some amazing breakthroughs here! This is all because of my great work! I guess you've done okay yourself. Maybe you can try one more time to prove your worth as an assistant.\r\n

yes.0: I need to run a control group, but all my old rubble samples have been damaged or partially digested. I'll need a full array of samples if I'm going to lock this down. Bring me 30 each of the following: Stone Golem Rubbles, Dark Stone Golem Rubbles, Mixed Golem Rubbles, Frozen Stones, and Burning Stones. You do that, and you'll go down in history as a pretty good assistant!

no.0: You're really turning me down?! It's one more thing! Come on!

1.0: Thanks to you, my research is complete! You are definitely in the top 300 assistants I've ever had.I've concluded, through hours of painstaking study, that golems really are living piles of rock! Isn't that neat?!\r\n

yes.0: If you're looking for adventure, you should head down to the Mushroom Castle at the end of the Singing Mushroom Forest. It's a popular place with tourists and adventurers. Not for the same reasons, of course.
